title: Complete PIX checkout successfully

Verify a payment confirmation is visible

title: Add a photo to the cart from discovery

Open one of the matching photos
Add the photo to the cart
Verify the cart contains the selected photo

Add the photo to the cart
Verify the selected photo is listed in the cart
Verify the cart shows at least one item
